rationale.A: Herttoniemi paths beside Mekaanikonkatu/Varikkotie, then 1.75 km mixed (Kulosaaren puistotie, Sompasaarenlaituri); many unsignalised crossings
rationale.B: Rides Mekaanikonkatu, Laivalahdenkatu and Hitsaajankatu in traffic: ~3.9 km mixed on 40 km/h industrial streets; 9 lights
rationale.C: A's corridor with Capellan puistotie and the Pohjoisranta/Kaivokatu finish; ~1.7 km mixed; 8 lights
rationale.D: Same corridor as A, but the Kalasatama section is on paths; ~1.2 km mixed; 4 lights
rationale.E: Via Laajasalo shore paths and the car-free Kruunuvuorensilta bridge; only ~650 m in light traffic; +9 min
rationale.F: A's corridor then Sörnäinen/Hämeentie; ~1.5 km mixed; 15 lights
rationale.G: Like F via Hermannin rantatie and Haukilahdenkatu; ~2.1 km mixed; 18 lights
rationale.H: No mixed traffic, but ~4.5 km beside 40–50 km/h roads (Viikintie, Viilarintie) and unsignalised arterial crossings; +18 min

notes: Calm pick E costs +9 min on a 45-min ride, but several km move from roadside paths and Kulosaaren puistotie traffic onto shore paths and a car-free bridge. Ambiguous: a stricter reader of 'ten minutes is too much' might choose null.
